idle.description: Waiting for user trigger such as 'standup', '/standup', or 'daily standup'. The skill is idle until invoked.

detecting-dates.description: Running date range auto-detection: backward catch-up scan of existing .standup/ files for missing author entries, computing forward range of new dates, and merging into a deduplicated sorted target list.

DATES_DETECTED.description: Target dates computed successfully; at least one date to process.

NOTHING_TO_GENERATE.description: No dates need standup files; both forward range and missing_dates are empty.

collecting-data.description: Executing Get-StandupData.ps1 for the current target date. The script auto-detects the author from git config and filters sessions by repo and turn timestamps.

DATA_COLLECTED.description: Session data retrieved for the current date.

DATA_COLLECTION_FAILED.description: Failed to retrieve session data for the current date.

composing-entries.description: Filtering sessions to current author, classifying work status as done or in-progress, grouping by branch and topic, and formatting entries per the standup template.

ENTRIES_COMPOSED.description: Entries composed from session data; ready for git verification.

NO_ENTRIES.description: No usable session entries and no git commits for this date; skip without writing an empty section.

cross-checking-git.description: Cross-referencing entries with git commits filtered to the current user via git log --author. Verifying done status and checking for unrecorded work items.

GIT_VERIFIED.description: Git cross-check complete; done status verified.

GIT_CHECK_FAILED.description: Git cross-check failed (corrupted repo, missing git, permission denied).

NO_ENTRIES.description: Cross-check produced no entries for this date; skip without writing an empty section.

checking-dedup.description: Checking whether the standup file for this date exists and whether it already contains an Author section for the current user. Determines whether to write fresh or append.

AUTHOR_ABSENT.description: File does not exist or has no section for this author; will create fresh.

AUTHOR_PRESENT.description: File exists with other authors but not this one; will append section.

DEDUP_CHECK_FAILED.description: Dedup check failed (file read error, permissions).

ALREADY_RECORDED.description: All composed entries for this author already recorded for this date; skip without writing.

writing-fresh.description: Creating a new standup file from the canonical template at assets/templates/standup.md. Populating all placeholder tokens with real values for the current author and date.

FILE_WRITTEN.description: Fresh standup file written to .standup/ directory.

appending-author.description: Appending the current author's ## @<name> section to the existing standup file. Merging entries according to dedup rules (composite key: feature title, branch, author).

ENTRY_APPENDED.description: Author section appended to existing standup file.

APPEND_FAILED.description: Failed to append author section to standup file.

next-date-or-complete.description: Evaluating whether more target dates remain to process. Increments the date index and either loops back to collecting-data for the next date or transitions to complete.

MORE_DATES.description: More target dates remain; processing the next date.

ALL_DATES_DONE.description: All target dates processed; standup generation complete.

nothing-to-generate.description: No dates need standup files. Reported 'Standup is current — nothing to generate.' to the user.

complete.description: All target dates processed and standup files written or updated in .standup/ directory. Multi-author merge complete.

error.description: An error occurred during standup generation. The run has been aborted.
